howToPlay: Manage your Heat levels carefully to maximize damage output from your basic attacks and Super. Use the Overcooked gadget for extra pressure or Made With Love to provide utility by healing allies. Balance your aggression to ensure you always have enough energy stored to release a powerful explosion.
gears: Equip DAMAGE to increase your output when low on health, SHIELD to improve your survivability, or GADGET COOLDOWN to use your special abilities more frequently.
trait: This brawler suits a strategic player who enjoys managing resources to control the pace of combat.
